Class Car

java.lang.Object
traffic.model.Vehicle
traffic.model.Car
All Implemented Interfaces:
Movable
public class Car extends Vehicle
A car: a specific type of vehicle that can seek parking and has various driving parameters. Inherits the basic position/speed/state fields and methods from Vehicle.
